edges.reason: msg.sender selects the pool account whose reward is paid out in preClaimDollar.
claim() accounts rewards for the caller.
bond() credits the caller's bonded balance.
unbond() debits the caller's bonded balance.
deposit() pulls LP tokens from the caller.
purchaseCoupons() burns dollar from the caller.
transferCoupons() may spend the caller's coupon allowance.
redeem() burns from and pays out to the caller.
vote() reads the caller's bonded dollar stake.
addPool() is gated on msg.sender == address(this) (self/governance call).
pendingReward() reads pool state for msg.sender.
_addLiquidity() pulls both tokens from msg.sender via safeTransferFrom.
vote() requires msg.sender == tx.origin, an origin-based authorization check.
advance() requires msg.sender == tx.origin before minting the incentive.
epochTime() derives protocol time directly from block.timestamp.
advance() epoch progression depends on timestamp-derived epoch time.
preClaimDollar() performs an external dollar transfer to msg.sender before state is finalised.
The external token transfer can callback into claim() before postClaimDollar() resets rewardDebt.
The external token transfer can re-enter bond() while reward debt is stale.
_addLiquidity() performs external safeTransferFrom calls on caller-supplied tokens.
_sellAndDepositCollateral() forwards control to an untrusted Uniswap pair via swap().
A malicious token/pair can re-enter the selling loop while actualSold/state is inconsistent.
_sellAndDepositCollateral() mints and transfers dollar before swapping.
mintToAccount() calls dollar().mint().
burnFromAccountForDebt() calls transferFrom and burn on the dollar token.
clipToAccount() transfers dollar to the account.
redeem() transfers VSD from the caller and safeTransfers each collateral asset.
redeem() finishes by burning the redeemed amount through burnFromAccountForDebt().
upgradeTo() delegatecalls initialize() on an arbitrary new implementation.
commit() triggers the upgrade path only after governor and quorum checks.
emergencyCommit() triggers the upgrade path with super-majority and governor checks.
setImplementation() writes the implementation slot with inline assembly.
upgradeTo() first stores the new implementation via setImplementation().
Regulator.step() obtains the price from oracleCapture().
oracleCapture() performs the external oracle().capture() call.
_getDollarReserve() queries pool reserves, token0/token1 and totalSupply externally.
_updateReserve() aggregates reserves through _getDollarReserve() for every pool.
Reserve pro-rating multiplies and divides by unbounded reserve/LP values.
Sell amount allocation multiply/divide and the final assert(actualSold <= totalSellAmount) rely on raw arithmetic.
advance() is protected by the nonReentrant modifier.
claim() calls postClaimDollar() after paying out.
claim() calls preClaimDollar() before bookkeeping.
redeemOutstandingCoupons() reads and caps against totalRedeemable().
clipRedeemedCoupon() prorates the user coupon balance against the redeemed coupon total.
burnFromAccountForDebt() decrements the global debt balance.
Regulator supply growth calls increaseSupply() with the mint amount.
purchaseCoupons() burns the paid dollar through burnFromAccount().
purchaseCoupons() burns dollar from msg.sender via the external token.
bond() resets reward debt via postClaimDollar().
unbond() resets reward debt via postClaimDollar().
provide() resets reward debt via postClaimDollar().
advance() mints the incentive through incentivize().
increaseSupply() increments the redeemable balance via mintToRedeemable().
resetDebt() reduces the stored debt balance.

normalization_plan.reason: The pool parameter only scopes the withdraw() accounting lookup.
The value parameter is consumed solely by withdraw() for staged balance maths.
The pool parameter selects the bond() pool entry.
The value parameter is used only to credit bonded balance in bond().
dollarAmount drives the burn and coupon premium inside purchaseCoupons().
The candidate id is used only within vote() for nomination and tally lookups.
The candidate address is cast to the new implementation inside commit().
newImplementation is the target of the delegatecall executed during upgrade.
value determines the collateral payout and burn inside redeem().
The account parameter is the mint destination for the incentive.
The amount parameter is the mint quantity for the incentive.
The pool parameter selects the Uniswap pair used by provide().
couponAmount is used only within the extendCoupon liveness computation.
amount is consumed only by transferCoupons balance and allowance updates.
pending is the clamped reward value local to the preClaimDollar payout path.
actual is the redeemed amount local to the redeem() collateral loop.
pending is the returned value computed inside pendingReward().
sellAmount is the amount fed into the sell-and-deposit collateral routine.
bondedLP is the per-pool bonded amount passed into reserve pro-rating.
vsdRedeemable is the capped redemption result local to the redemption routine.
